floaters.title: Clean floating voxels
floaters.explain: A noisy scan has specks floating in the air. The walls turn each speck into a small solid piece, and the drone crashes into it although nothing is there. This removes every piece that touches no big wall and is smaller than the size below.
floaters.block: 1 block = a cube of {cm} cm, 4×4×4 voxels.
floaters.effect: Removes floating pieces: {pieces} · blocks: {blocks}. The big walls stay.
floaters.effectNone: Nothing is removed: no piece is that small.
floaters.effectOff: Off: every piece stays a wall.
floaters.suggested: One click uses the suggested size: under {n} blocks (only small pieces, together under 1 % of the walls).
floaters.nothing: No small floating pieces on this scan: nothing to clean.
floaters.appliedNow: This scan flies with: pieces under {n} blocks removed.
floaters.appliedOff: This scan flies with every piece as a wall.
